No. 2086/5 – MONDAY AUGUST 27, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No. : 4/1/1/32/H/147 Land Ministry No.: 4-3-7/ 2016/HW/180 I do hereby given notice under Sub Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitudes which required for a public purpose to information of public.
Description of the land acquired :

Two (02) lots of in extent of 0.4899 hectares depicted as Lot No. 267 and 268 in Preliminary plan No. ý 2356 of 24.07.2018 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General Situated in the Village of Ganegedara, in No. 830, Madithiyawela Grama Niladari Divisions of Kurunegala Divisional Secretary’s Division in Kurunegala District to North Western Province and further described as follows.

1. Lot No. 267 Name of the Land: Pilalandewatta or Hitinawatta; Land Use : Mix plantation and Garden, parts of Permanent building and a masonary Well; Claimant: Sate; Original Claimant: N. J. D. Ganededara, “Siriniwasa”, Ganegedara, Boyagane; Extent : 0.2948 Hectare. 2. Lot No. 268 Name of the Land: Pilalandewatta or Hitinawatta; Land Use : Mix Plantation and Garden, a Permanent
building; Claimant: Sate; Original Claimant: N. J. D. Ganededara, “Siriniwasa”, Ganegedara, Boyagane; Extent : 0.1951 Hectare.

All persons whom interested in the aforesaid lands/servitudes is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or through an agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Kurunegala on the day of 10.09.2018. The nature of their claims for Compensation for the said lands/servitudes the amount of compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount. Further the person should appear for an inquiry under section 09 of the Act commence from 25.09.2018 on wards. The date of inquiry and the relevant documents submit at the inquiry such as deeds may duly informed by me.

If an agent may present at the inquiry, original claimant of the land must be duly authorized in writing. Without such a letter, statement or evidence may not be recorded from such an agent. E. M. M. S. EKANAYAKA, Divisional Secretary, And Land Acquiring Officer, Kurunegala. Divisional Secretariat, Kurunegala 20th August, 2018 09 - 223

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No. : 4/1/1/32/E. Land Ministry No.: 4-3-7/ 2015/HW/69. I do hereby given notice under Sub Section (1) of Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitudes which required for a public purpose to information of public.
Description of the land acquired :

Four (04) lots in extent of 0.2930 hectare depicted as Preliminary Plan No. ý 2402 of 29.06.2018 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General Situated in the village of Ambalanpitiya, in No. 836, Kurunegala town East and Weherabenda Grama Niladari Divisions of Kurunegala Divisional Secretary’s Division in Kurunegala District to North Western Province and further described as follows:

1. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Paragahakotuwekumbura Present Garden; Land Use : Open Waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: L. K. B. N. Weerasinghe, No. 16/A, Ruwan Bodhi Road, Kandy Road, Kurunegala; Extent : 0.0860 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Paragahakotuwekumbura Present Garden; Land Use: Garden with mixed plantation permanent building and a masonary Well; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: J. A. Nalani, No. 31/2, Railway Road, Kurunegala; Extent : 0.1080 Hectare.
3. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Dangahamulawatta; Land Use : Garden with mixed plantation three of Permanent
buildings and a masonary well; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: D. M. A. N. Dasanayaka, Kolapelalikanda watta, Ambalampitiya, Kurunegala; Extent : 0.0452 Hectare.

4. Lot No. 04 Name of the Land: Dangahamulawatta; Land Use : Garden with mixed plantation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: H. M. Yasomenika, Palipanawatta, Ambalampitiya, Kurunegala; Extent : 0.0538 Hectare.

All persons whom interested in the aforesaid lands/servitudes is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or through an agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Kurunegala on the day of 10.09.2018. The nature of their claims for Compensation for the said lands/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount. Further the person should appear for an inquiry section 09 of the act commence from 25.09.2018 on wards. The date of inquiry and the relevant documents submit at the inquiry such as deeds may duly informed by me.
If an agent may present at the inquiry, original claimant of the land must be duly authorized in writing. Without such a letter, statement or evidence may not be recorded from such an agent.
E. M. M. S. EKANAYAKA, Divisional Secretary, And Land Acquiring Officer, Kurunegala. Divisional Secretariat, Kurunegala, 20th August, 2018.
